notes: Implemented Phase 3: Progress Bar When Adding Images. Added imageLoadingProgress reactive state, onProgress callback to ImageLibrary.addImages(), wired progress through file handlers and drop handler, added accessible progress overlay (role=progressbar with ARIA attributes) to canvas container, and CSS for the overlay. World-review caught 3 issues: (1) callback signature mismatch in createFileHandlers.js — fixed by passing Vue instance as first argument matching the onRegenerate pattern, (2) stuck progress overlay on image load failure — fixed with try/finally blocks, (3) no concurrency guard — added early return in beginImageLoading when overlay already visible. All 1385 tests pass.
